turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on much and many?
turns.tutor:
I will think out loud first: "How ___ chairs are in the room?"
I look at "chairs". I can count chairs: one, two, three.
Things I can count go with many. So: How many chairs are in the room?
Rule: if you can count the things one by one, use many.
Right: I have many pens. Wrong: I have much pens.
Your turn. Write one word:
Write much or many: How ___ bottles are there?
